# Assessment Overview

This directory contains the supplementary fact documents generated for the PhotoAlbum assessment report.

## Available Documents

- [`architecture-diagram.md`](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level architecture diagrams for the web application.
- [`dependency-map.md`](./dependency-map.md) - Declared production and test dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [`api-service-contracts.md`](./api-service-contracts.md) - Browser-facing endpoints, service contracts, and request flow documentation.
- [`data-architecture.md`](./data-architecture.md) - Database, entity, persistence, and data ownership documentation.
- [`configuration-inventory.md`](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, secrets flow, and runtime version inventory.
- [`business-workflows.md`](./business-workflows.md) - Primary user workflows, domain mapping, and business-rule summaries.
